about.title: Introduction
about.introduction: Hi my name is Ahmed Mohamed
about.description: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with a B.S. in <degree>Software Engineering</degree> (2023 graduate) and 2+ years of experience building responsive, scalable web applications across modern stacks. Skilled in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Spring Boot, Laravel, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, and RESTful API development.
about.descriptionBottom: Continuously learning and adapting—comfortable with Git, modern tooling, and deploying full-stack applications to platforms like Vercel and Netlify.

realtimeChatApp.name: Realtime Chatapp
realtimeChatApp.description: Chat app with authentication, online status, and WebSocket messaging.
realtimeChatApp.longDescription: A full-stack realtime messaging application that allows users to communicate instantly in a modern chat interface. The app supports authentication, user search, and realtime message delivery using WebSockets.

highlights.authentication: Built authentication and protected user routes.
highlights.interface: Designed a responsive messaging interface with realtime UI updates.

realtimeChatApp.contribution: Designed and developed the frontend and backend, including authentication, realtime communication, API integration, and database functionality.

expenseTracker.name: Expense Tracker
expenseTracker.description: I'm <name>Ahmed</name>, a Full-Stack Developer focused on building fast, scalable, and thoughtfully designed web applications with modern technologies.
expenseTracker.longDescription: A modern full-stack expense tracking application that helps users manage their income and expenses efficiently. The app provides real-time budgeting insights, categorized transactions, and a clean dashboard UI for better financial tracking.

highlights.api: Built a full-stack REST API for financial data.
highlights.redux: Implemented centralized state management with Redux.
highlights.visualization: Created a dashboard for visualizing income, expenses, and budgets.

expenseTracker.contribution: Developed the frontend and backend, implemented state management, API integration, database operations, and the responsive dashboard interface.

todoApp.name: Todo App
todoApp.description: Todo app with task management and real-time updates using Spring Boot and React.
todoApp.longDescription: A RESTful backend API for the Todo App, built with Java / Spring Boot, containerized with Docker, and powered by Supabase (PostgreSQL) as the cloud database.

highlights.api: Designed a RESTful API using Spring Boot.
highlights.jpa: Mapped application data to PostgreSQL using JPA.

todoApp.contribution: Developed the Spring Boot backend and React frontend, implemented REST APIs, database integration, state management, and Docker configuration.
